         # not a data type (e.g. a column named dtype in a pandas DataFrame)
         dtype_orig = None
 
+    # DataFrame with the same dtype for all columns (e.g. built with
+    # ``pd.DataFrame(..., dtype=object)``) does not expose a ``dtype``
+    # attribute directly, but rather a ``dtypes`` attribute (a Series of
+    # dtypes, one per column). In that case we still want ``warn_on_dtype``
+    # to be able to detect a dtype conversion, so we recover the original
+    # dtype when all the columns share the same one.
+    if dtype_orig is None and hasattr(array, 'dtypes') and hasattr(
+            array.dtypes, '__array__'):
+        dtypes_orig = list(array.dtypes)
+        if all(dt == dtypes_orig[0] for dt in dtypes_orig):
+            dtype_orig = dtypes_orig[0]
